target_role: Manager of Applied AI Architecture, Partnerships
headline_line: SVP Engineering | Alliance Co-Sell Motions | Runtime Reliability Governance | Enterprise Portfolio Expansion

summary.text: An engineering executive leads governed agentic AI platform architecture and regulated release-delivery discipline as one integrated operating model. Designs an SVP-level agentic platform control plane spanning agent workflow coordination contracts, human override escalation paths, and controlled execution surfaces that keep autonomous systems auditable at enterprise scale. Software dependency graph intelligence enables accelerated legacy-system analysis, exposes architecture dependency chains, and improves transformation visibility across enterprise complexity. In parallel, that same governed runtime discipline extends into productized platform leadership, turning platform architecture into an operating asset rather than a one-off build. That operating foundation also converted platform productization into $22M in IP-led revenue while scaling team capacity behind the platform. This combination of governed runtime architecture, release-security discipline, and platform commercialization leadership positions the executive to translate frontier AI capability into repeatable, partner-ready enterprise deployment patterns.

Standardized the AI systems lifecycle from intake through production monitoring, compressing lab-to-production cycle time from six months to three weeks through replayable runtime design.

Engineered high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms, integrating Databricks Lakehouse data pipelines and dense-sparse retrieval design across cloud-native execution layers.
Scaled the platform engineering team from 8 to 28 while converting bespoke client delivery into reusable AI platform IP through an operating model built for agentic platform commercialization.
